name: AddIns
description: A collection of AddIn objects that represent all the Microsoft PowerPoint-specific add-ins available to PowerPoint, regardless of whether or not they are loaded. This does not include Component Object Model (COM) add-ins.
example:
For Each ad In AddIns

    If ad.Loaded Then MsgBox ad.Name

Next

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Addin object from the specified Addins collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number of the single Addin object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns an AddIn object that represents an add-in file added to the list of add-ins.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The full name of the file (including the path and file name extension) that contains the add-in you want to add to the list of add-ins.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an add-in from the collection of add-ins.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number of the add-in to be removed from the collection.
